shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving on a flat frontal face
bent/angled limb-like motif rendered in relief
plain undecorated lower zone beneath the carved area
rounded or squared upper termination above the carved panel
justification: Both are tall monolithic stone slabs bearing shallow, flat-topped relief carving confined to the upper portion, with the lower part left plain, and both include an angular bent limb-like element rendered as a raised outline. However, A is a dense, fully anthropomorphic composition with head, arms, belt, discs and bands covering the whole surface, while B carries a single sparse profile animal-like motif on an otherwise blank, smoothly dressed face beneath a projecting T-shaped top, so the compositional logic and degree of elaboration differ sharply.
